guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, kmac_en_o is set to 0, sha3_mode_o to sha3_pkg::Sha3, and keccak_strength_o to sha3_pkg::L256.
When rst_ni is high and clr_appid is high, kmac_en_o, sha3_mode_o, and keccak_strength_o are loaded from reg_kmac_en_i, reg_sha3_mode_i, and reg_keccak_strength_i respectively.

When rst_ni is high, clr_appid is low, and set_appid is high, kmac_en_o is 1 if AppCfg[arb_idx].Mode == AppKMAC else 0; sha3_mode_o is sha3_pkg::Sha3 if AppCfg[arb_idx].Mode == AppSHA3 else sha3_pkg::CShake; keccak_strength_o is assigned AppCfg[arb_idx].KeccakStrength.
When rst_ni is high, clr_appid and set_appid are both low, and st equals StIdle, kmac_en_o, sha3_mode_o, and keccak_strength_o are loaded from reg_kmac_en_i, reg_sha3_mode_i, reg_keccak_strength_i.
guarantees.cond: st == StIdle and clr_appid == 0 and set_appid == 0 (no reset)

assumptions.claim: clr_appid and set_appid are mutually exclusive; they are never both high at the same time.
assumptions.risk: Simultaneous assertion causes set_appid configuration to be ignored and the block loads register values, potentially preserving stale or incorrect mode/strength for an application.

assumptions.claim: When set_appid is high, arb_idx points to a valid entry in AppCfg, and that entry's Mode and KeccakStrength fields contain legal, intended values.
assumptions.risk: An out-of-range arb_idx or illegal field value drives kmac_en_o, sha3_mode_o, or keccak_strength_o to an invalid configuration, leading to misbehavior or security weakness in the SHA-3 core.

uncertain_points.claim: If both clr_appid and set_appid are asserted, the block silently discards the set_appid configuration. Is this intended, and does the handshake logic guarantee mutual exclusion?
uncertain_points.risk: Application configuration may be lost, causing the block to operate with previous or default settings.

uncertain_points.claim: keccak_strength_o is assigned directly from AppCfg[arb_idx].KeccakStrength without any validity check. If an illegal strength value is written (e.g., by software error), it reaches the SHA-3 core unchanged.
uncertain_points.cond: set_appid or reg load with invalid KeccakStrength value
uncertain_points.risk: The SHA-3 core may weaken security (e.g., use non-standard rounds) or malfunction, potentially breaking integrity/confidentiality of the MAC or hash output.
